title: Lower bound on critical tribe size
statement: For each integer $w\ge4$, define a candidate size $s$ by $1-(1-2^{-w})^s\le 1/2$, and let the critical size be the greatest such candidate among integers at most $2^{w+2}$. Then $2^{w-2}$ is at most the critical size.
